_comment: Intended roster of seeded test users for the account-pool broker (account-pool-mcp). GENERATED, do not hand-edit: edit config/test-user-roster.yaml (the source of truth for who should exist) and re-run scripts/build-account-pool-seed.py. The same roster generates the PL/SQL that CREATES these users, via scripts/build-test-user-sql.py, so the pool and the database cannot drift. SCHEMA (verified against the running 0.3.0 host build, QA-182): customers -> <customer> -> <role> -> [{id, credentials}]. The broker COMPOSES the colon forms at load time: pool key '<customer>:<role>' (e.g. mred:realtor) and account id '<customer>:<id>' (e.g. mred:TREALTOR1). Those colon strings never appear in this file, and there is no flat 'pools' map and no hyphen convention (both were the pre-QA-182 model, now dead: a bare or hyphenated pool name does not resolve). FLOOR OF 10 USERS PER TYPE: a type the roster declares with fewer is widened to 10 here so parallel sessions cannot exhaust a pool of one. THIS RUNS AHEAD OF THE DATABASE. A widened user does not exist until the seed SQL is re-run for that customer, so the broker would hand out an account that cannot log in. Check with scripts/verify-account-pool-seed.py BEFORE the host operator installs this roster. POOL NAMES are this repo's and the live broker's ('dr' not 'drealtor', 'staff' not 'mlsstaff'), mapped from the roster's labels; usernames stay 'T<LABEL><n>'. TWO ACCOUNT FORMS (QA-280). A pool projected from a roster 'offices:' batch is a connectMLS user the seed SQL creates, its id IS its username, and it is floor-widened. A pool projected from a roster 'pools:' block is an account that ALREADY EXISTS and that no generator creates (the board fixtures qc-realtor / hrtlnd-*, and non-connectMLS products such as connectHUB); it is emitted verbatim and never widened, its id may be a role label rather than a username, and a credential value may be an environment reference {env: VAR} the broker resolves at lease time. NO SECRETS AND NO ADDRESSES HERE, IN EITHER FORM. The broker resolves every credential and RETURNS it in the lease result (only pool_status strips them), so an {env: VAR} reference keeps a value out of git but not out of the caller's transcript. For connectMLS the shared TEST_USER_PASSWORD stays in config/env/.env.<customer>, is read by scripts/auth, and is never read by the agent. For connectHUB the pooled value is the ROLE LABEL only: the address and password stay in the gitignored .env.connecthub and are resolved inside node by label, so a lease answers who holds a role and never reveals whose mailbox it is (QA-276). PUBLISHED IN TWO PLACES (QA-281): this file, and a byte-identical copy at account-pool-mcp/seed/account-pool.seed.json, so a deploy carries its own roster and needs no qa-tooling clone on the host. The generator writes both; a qa-tooling push refuses when they disagree (scripts/account-pool-seed-lint.py). That gate compares the two COMMITTED copies in the local clones: it proves they agree, not that the broker's PR merged, deployed, or matches the file installed on the host. LOADING adds accounts, re-points one that moved between roles, and REMOVES one deleted here, all on restart, keyed on account id (removal is QA-281; before it, a deleted entry stayed leasable until someone hand-deleted the row on the host, and a broker older than that still behaves the old way). A live lease is never yanked: an account under one is kept and named in the log, and goes on a later restart once released or expired. Reconciliation is GLOBAL, so installing a partial roster removes everything it omits; install it whole. SCOPE: the TSUITE (agent) and TADMIN (board) offices only. The second-office T2* suites exist in the MRED and MIBOR DBs but are deliberately NOT pooled (engineer direction 2026-07-30). Contract, pool catalog and the live divergence: scripts/auth/README.md. Source roster: fixtures/test-users.md.
